sections.heading: Discharge diagnoses
sections.text:
PRINCIPAL
Acute on chronic systolic (congestive) heart failure
SECONDARY
Atrial fibrillation, rate controlled
Chronic kidney disease, stage 3
Hypokalemia, resolved

sections.heading: Reason for admission
sections.text: 67-year-old man with HFrEF, persistent atrial fibrillation on apixaban and CKD stage 3 who presented with 5 days of progressive dyspnea, orthopnea and a 4.5 kg weight gain. BNP 1,840 pg/mL. Chest X-ray showed bilateral pleural effusions and pulmonary vascular congestion.

sections.heading: Hospital course
sections.text: Treated with IV furosemide with net negative 5.2 L over 4 days; discharge weight 89.6 kg (dry weight estimate). Transthoracic echocardiogram on 10/06/2026 showed LVEF 30-35% (previously 40%), moderate functional mitral regurgitation and a mildly dilated left atrium. Guideline-directed therapy was advanced: spironolactone and empagliflozin were started and tolerated. Furosemide was changed to torsemide for more reliable absorption. Potassium fell to 3.2 mmol/L during diuresis and was repleted; 3.9 mmol/L at discharge. Creatinine peaked at 1.9 mg/dL and was 1.7 mg/dL at discharge (baseline 1.6). Heart rate 70-85 in atrial fibrillation on metoprolol.

sections.heading: Condition at discharge
sections.text: Stable. Ambulating independently. Room air SpO2 95%. No orthopnea.

sections.heading: Discharge medications
sections.text:
Status Medication Instructions
NEW Torsemide 20 mg tablet Take 1 tablet (20 mg) by mouth once daily
NEW Spironolactone 25 mg tablet Take ½ tablet (12.5 mg) by mouth once daily
NEW Empagliflozin 10 mg tablet Take 1 tablet by mouth once daily
CONTINUE Apixaban 5 mg tablet Take 1 tablet by mouth twice daily
CONTINUE Metoprolol succinate ER 50 mg tablet Take 1 tablet by mouth once daily
STOP Furosemide 40 mg tablet Stop taking. Replaced by torsemide.

sections.heading: Follow-up
sections.text:
Basic metabolic panel (potassium, creatinine) in 1 week, ordered by PCP.
PCP visit with Dr. Ibarra within 7 days of discharge (by 10/16/2026).
Cardiology clinic (Dr. Helena Marsh) in 2 weeks to titrate guideline-directed therapy and discuss repeat echo in 3 months.
Weigh daily each morning. Call the clinic for a gain of more than 1 kg in a day or 2 kg in a week.

sections.heading: Diet and activity
sections.text: 2 g sodium diet. Fluid limit 1.5 L per day. Walk daily as tolerated; no heavy lifting for 1 week.
